prompt:
Editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, hand-painted Japanese book-illustration feel: delicate dark pencil contours, soft organic painted washes, subtle paper texture, warm ivory paper tones. Palette: cream, warm sand, charcoal gray, muted sage green, warm timber wood, muted brick-red accents. Landscape 4:3 composition, FULL-BLEED: the painting fills the whole canvas edge to edge, with NO frame, NO border line, NO mat and NO paper margin around it.
People, when present: young male student = slightly messy short dark hair, cream long-sleeved shirt, charcoal trousers, black backpack; young woman = chin-length dark bob with bangs, cream cardigan over muted brick-red top, charcoal skirt, small brown shoulder bag.

Subject: Two friends sit at a cozy kotatsu table chatting; one gestures with an open hand as if asking about somewhere far away. On the wall behind them hangs a plain watercolor picture of a snowy northern landscape with a pine tree, and a small suitcase sits by the door. A warm winter indoor mood. Keep every important element inside the central horizontal band of the canvas.
Keep the main subject in the central area so the image survives cropping to a thumbnail.

STRICT REQUIREMENTS:
- Absolutely NO text, letters, kanji, kana, numbers or words anywhere: signs, boards, labels and screens stay completely blank.
- Clock faces have NO digits and NO Roman numerals.
- Hand-painted watercolor gouache look, NOT 3D, NOT CGI, NOT glossy vector, NOT photo.

suggestedAlt.vi: Hai người bạn ngồi bên bàn sưởi nói chuyện về chuyến đi mùa đông, sau lưng là bức tranh phong cảnh tuyết phía bắc và chiếc vali nhỏ.
